captions.detailed: This 3D model features a pair of image-stabilized binoculars. It consists of two main black cylindrical barrels with dark teal lenses, connected by a central bridge assembly. Atop the bridge is an internal stabilizing prism block in light blue, and a raised, textured black focus wheel assembly. The barrels pivot outward on a revolute joint to adjust the interpupillary distance, while the focus wheel rotates continuously.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of image-stabilized binoculars with two black objective barrels and teal lenses. Connect them via a central bridge that supports a light blue prism block and a raised black focus wheel, ensuring the barrels can pivot to adjust interpupillary distance and the focus wheel can rotate continuously.
captions.factory: Construct the binoculars by defining an assembly with multiple parts. Model the central bridge as a base link. Create the left and right objective barrels using combined cylinder primitives for the body and thin cylinder disks for the teal lenses. Add a prism block on the bridge using a wedge or box primitive with a light blue material. Model the focus wheel on a raised arm using a cylinder with small rectangular ridges. Define a revolute joint for each barrel to pivot around the central bridge axis, and a continuous joint for the rotating focus wheel.
